name: agentlens
description: Root-cause a production issue from its Zendesk ticket ID: Zendesk, Langfuse, Sentry and the cross-service map, from any machine.

workspace_name.title: Default workspace name
workspace_name.description: These settings are saved as a workspace with this name, so /lens-workspace can switch back to them. Letters, digits, - and _.

zendesk_email.title: Zendesk email (API token only)
zendesk_email.description: Leave empty when the token below is an OAuth token. Fill in your Zendesk login email only if you use an API token.

zendesk_token.title: Zendesk token
zendesk_token.description: A read-scoped OAuth token from a Zendesk admin (preferred), or an API token. Fallback when no workspace is active (see /lens-workspace).

langfuse_host.title: Langfuse host
langfuse_host.description: Base URL of the Langfuse instance, no trailing slash.

langfuse_public_key.title: Langfuse public key
langfuse_public_key.description: The pk-lf-... half of the RCA key pair. Fallback when no workspace is active (see /lens-workspace).

langfuse_secret_key.title: Langfuse secret key
langfuse_secret_key.description: The sk-lf-... half of the RCA key pair. Fallback when no workspace is active (see /lens-workspace).

crafter_host.title: Agent Crafter host
crafter_host.description: Base URL of the Agent Crafter (DRM) instance /heal builds against, no trailing slash. Saved as the default workspace for tm-agent-crafter too. Enter it with the API key below, or leave both empty.

crafter_api_key.title: Agent Crafter API key
crafter_api_key.description: drm_pub_xxx.drm_sk_xxx, issued in Django admin under API Keys.
